§ 1 — Definitions and mathematics ¶

Let SS be a set. Equation 1 states that every element equals itself.

Equation 1 — Identity ¶

In symbols, for x∈Sx \in S:

∀x∈S,x=x \forall x \in S,\quad x=x

The surrounding prose remains readable independently of mathematical typesetting. A strong assertion, emphasis, a discarded claim, and inline code illustrate ordinary Markdown. See the definition and the proof.

Definition 1.1 — Reflexivity ¶

A relation RR on SS is reflexive if each element is related to itself.

Theorem 1.1 — Equality is reflexive ¶

Equality satisfies Definition 1.1 because every element equals itself.

Proof ¶

The identity x=xx=x holds for each element of SS. Thus the relation is reflexive.
